liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Unusual transition from Franklin's Tower, with Weir stepping forward during the ending jam [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-03-28.164338.nak300.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1989-03-28.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.124994.Flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 158 min [3]
- **gd1989-03-28.148154.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1989-03-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81529.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 163 min; rated 3.67/5 by 15 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is gorgeously mixed with plenty of crowd noise from the start [17]

## Around the show

- Crowd formed a drum circle with flag poles near CNN Center after the show [13]
- A woman moaned during the song, which the listener found amusing and intense [15]
- Listener confirms the flagpole incident occurred in the 1990s, not 1989 [16]
- New diamond lighting rig was introduced and tested at the Omni venue [18]
- Listener was arrested by red dog squad cops but rescued by their supervisor [19]
- Listener found the show okay but preferred the superb Greensboro venue for the same week [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-03-28.164338.nak300.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony D5M [1]
- **gd1989-03-28.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.124994.Flac1644**: taped by fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes Maxell MX-90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg… [3]. Also: Fitzy recorded the show, sharing his source with lots of crowd participation [3]
- **gd1989-03-28.148154.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [5]
- **gd1989-03-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81529.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [6]. Also: Tapes supplied by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, transferred from unknown mics to DAT [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead of the Day: [March 28, 1989](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/03-28-1989/) [25]
